rationale: Lowered proportional gain and added velocity-proportional brake plus stronger delay-compensated predictor, tightened rate limits and smooth high-level cap, and replaced slow narrow feedforward learner with faster settled-state learner (tau ~10-12s, wider band). This targets ~2x higher effective pump gain / ~0.15 lower threshold: old tuning holds 0.73 at u~0.62 and then oscillates when integral is increased, so loop gain must be reduced and u_star must be re-estimated online to ~0.55 instead of ~0.77.

extra.machine_card: Reservoir: positive gain, delay 2-4s, lag 8-15s, noise <0.03, strongly nonlinear steep gain 0.7-0.8, nominal u_star(0.6)~0.76. Changed: effective gain ~2x (u_star(0.6)~0.54-0.60, threshold down ~0.15), delay similar, drain similar/slightly reduced. Controller must adapt u_star 0.55-0.77 and keep delay margin for both.
extra.predicted_behavior: Changed machine: rise to 0.55-0.65 in 15-25s without exceeding 0.75, settle 0.60 +/-0.05, in-band >=0.70 after 30s, MAE ~0.03-0.05, no sustained 0.4-0.8 limit cycle. Nominal machine: rise in ~18-25s, settle 0.60 +/-0.05, in-band >=0.70 after 30s, energy similar to before. Prediction refutes/fails if still offset to 0.73 or oscillates >+/-0.08.
extra.diagnosis: Same command now produces larger steady level: discovery u=0.7 decays 0.43->0.37 (eq~0.37), u=0.75 rises 0.37->0.55 and 0.46->0.55, u=0.8 drives 0.39->0.61, so u_star_old~0.75-0.78 for 0.6. Post-change v1 holds sensor 0.72-0.75 for 90s at u~0.59-0.62 (ep0 t30-120, ep1-9 same), i.e. y_eq(u=0.62)~0.73 vs expected ~0.25. Ratio (0.73/0.37)*(0.70/0.62)~2.2x effective pump gain, or threshold shift down ~0.13-0.18. Drain at u=0.35 is slow (-0.008/s at 0.8 vs -0.018/s nominal), consistent with reduced outflow / stronger pump, not weaker/faster drain. Delay still 2-4s (rise starts after ~3-4s in both), so not primarily delay. When integral was increased (v2) loop oscillated 0.48-0.74 period ~50s, classic high-gain+delay instability, confirming gain increase.
